title: •Aratech Corporation
caption: •Aratech Corporation (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. AT-STs and speeder bikes are power and forfeit +1. During your deploy phase, may reveal an AT-ST or Speeder Bike from hand to ▲ a unique (•) Imperial pilot of ability < 3 (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously. {alter}
lore: Aratech Corporation sent support staff to various Imperial outposts and garrisons. Gave advanced briefings and training to biker scout personnel.

notes: Unique. The slip's heading prints '•Aratech Corporation(V)' (no space before (V)); the bottom strip prints '•Aratech Corporation (V)' (caption). Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. The slip prints ▲ where the stub expands 'Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; stub '(*)' = printed '(•)'; red circle-slash A at the end → {alter}. Lore matches the scan and the 745 px V0 remake. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright (Endor, 1999) not legible. Modern: V0-D-aratechcorporation.gif (745 px); VB3 (350) also exists, not downloaded.
